about.title: Who is Andres Enrique Ortiz Santa Cruz?
about.bio1: Hello, I'm Andres Enrique Ortiz Santa Cruz, a *Backend-oriented Full-Stack developer*.
about.bio2: I design and build web applications and services with *TypeScript, Node.js and React*, with a particular interest in *software architecture, distributed systems, AI and cybersecurity*.
about.utezDegree: University Technician in multiplatform software development.
about.orleansDegree: IT B.U.T (Bac +3) - Realization of applications: design, development, validation.
about.hobbiesText: Doing what you love is essential to maintain a balance between physical and mental health. That's why I prioritize some of my time to do my hobbies, as they not only help me stay fit and healthy, but also improve my mood, reduce stress and relax me. This gives me an escape from the daily hustle and bustle and allows me to forget about everything for a moment and clear my head.

game.title: Click the button as many times as you can

about.bio3: *Autonomous and adaptable*, I enjoy discovering new technologies and solving concrete technical problems, on both the backend and the frontend.
about.bio4: Outside of development, I'm into *working out*, new technologies and learning new things, as well as listening to music (Mexican, reggaeton, rap, pop, electronica) and playing video games with a good story.

aphilia.task1: Backend development: Design and implementation of REST APIs and modular microservices with NestJS, Express and Node.js.
aphilia.task2: Data management: MySQL, Redis and TypeORM.
aphilia.task3: AI integration: Design and integration of conversational agents and intelligent assistants (skill definition, rules engine and specialised prompts).
aphilia.task4: Monitoring & observability: Application performance tracking, dashboard configuration and metrics management with Datadog.
aphilia.task5: AI-assisted workflow: use of coding agents such as Claude Code to speed up delivery — framing the requirement, delegating the implementation, then reviewing and validating the generated code before merging.
